The economy shed 23,000 jobs in July. Economists had expected a gain of 80,000. 

Meanwhile, the unemployment rate slid to 4.1%.

🇺🇸 Where the US economy gained and lost jobs in July 

Government -53K

Retail trade -19K
Financial services -14K
Healthcare +22K
Construction +22K

🚨 Breaking: US economy unexpectedly posts negative job growth in July

Jobs added: -23K vs +80K expected
Unemployment rate: 4.1% vs 4.2% expected
